acceptance: DOMAIN_NODE_KINDS and DOMAIN_NODE_KIND_SPECS include Component, Feature, ProductRevision, and DeploymentTarget with closed deterministic metadata schemas while all previously qualified node and edge semantics remain compatible.
Component and Feature metadata cannot be interpreted as DesignSystemRevision binding, SkillRef execution, capability admission, or runtime proof.
ProductRevision metadata cannot grant source mutation, release, promotion, or deployment authority merely because the node exists.
DeploymentTarget metadata cannot contain or grant secret/network/deployment capability and cannot be interpreted as proof that a provider target is reachable or authorized.
Focused tests prove valid examples plus missing-required, unknown-field, wrong-type, deterministic issue ordering, and full canonical domain-validation compatibility.

The exact implementation candidate must pass repository format/lint/typecheck/tests, Diffcipline at the truthful risk tier, checksum-verified Alibaba Open Code Review, required credentialed Jev semantic review, exact-head CI, normal merge, and fresh-main CI before closure.

required: Focused endpoint metadata-contract tests plus full repository format/lint/typecheck/test suites.
Diffcipline proof, Alibaba OCR evidence, credentialed Jev semantic review, exact-head semantic review, and post-merge fresh-main CI.

minimality.rationale: The smallest safe S06 continuation is to add only the four missing endpoint node contracts required by already-canonical reference relations. Relation semantics remain a later independently reviewable Grain.

requirements: Metadata node existence never grants capability, credential, network, source-mutation, release, or deployment authority.
Component and Feature remain descriptive Product Graph semantics until explicit qualified relations are added later.
DeploymentTarget stores no secret material and is not proof of provider reachability or authorization.

outcome: The Product Graph can represent Component, Feature, ProductRevision, and DeploymentTarget as closed deterministic metadata nodes, providing typed endpoints required by canonical semantic-reference relations without widening existing relations or granting runtime authority.
rationale: SG-000029 established DesignSystemRevisionRef, SkillRef, ExplorationBranch, and Release. Canonical S06 relations BOUND_TO, MAY_USE, FORKS, PROMOTES, and TARGETS require Component, Feature, ProductRevision, and DeploymentTarget endpoints that are not yet present in the qualified domain-v1 vocabulary.

risk.recovery: Revert the Component, Feature, ProductRevision, and DeploymentTarget node-kind/spec additions and their focused tests; SG-000029 semantic reference nodes remain intact.

scope_in: Add a closed Component Product Graph node contract for a reusable UI/product primitive using inspectable metadata only; its existence must not imply a DesignSystemRevision binding.
Add a closed Feature Product Graph node contract for a user-visible capability using inspectable metadata only; its existence must not imply SkillRef execution or tool capability.

Add a closed ProductRevision Product Graph node contract for immutable/inspectable product revision identity and provenance metadata; its existence must not grant source mutation, release, or deployment authority.

Add a closed DeploymentTarget Product Graph node contract for target identity/type/environment/provenance metadata; its existence must not grant credentials, network access, deployment permission, or provider authority.
Extend only the existing deterministic Product Graph node validator and focused tests; preserve all previously qualified node and edge semantics unchanged.
scope_out: No BOUND_TO, MAY_USE, FORKS, PROMOTES, TARGETS edge kinds or endpoint pairs; no cross-node existence rules; no relation widening.
No component rendering, skill execution, branch mutation, source writes, release creation, deployment, provider calls, network access, secret handling, persistence/Supabase mutation, or P03 work.
No S07 DataSource/Field work, dataset relation work, ProductCompletenessManifest, VectorCorpus, or EvalDataset work.
title: IN-P02-S06-T01B semantic reference relation endpoint contracts
